title: Product Manager, Homepage
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.</p> <p>Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.</p> <p>We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Doing</strong></p> <p>You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.</p> <p>Here's what your day-to-day might look like:</p> <ul> <li>Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.</li> <li>Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.</li> <li>Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.</li> <li>Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Thrive</strong></p> <p>Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:</p> <ul> <li>Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.</li> <li>You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.</li> <li>You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.</li> <li>You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.</li> <li>You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.</li> <li>You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.</li> <li>You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).</li> <li>You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <p>The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!</p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc?si=FzuwoSOLcv5WZVRN" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.</p> <p>We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.</p> <p>If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.</p> <p>If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!</p> <p><em data-renderer-mark="true"><br>Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at</em> <a class="_ymio1r31 _ypr0glyw _zcxs1o36 _mizu194a _1ah3dkaa _ra3xnqa1 _128mdkaa _1cvmnqa1 _4davt94y _4bfu18uv _1hms8stv _ajmmnqa1 _vchhusvi _kqswh2mm _2rkolb4i _ect4ttxp _syaz13af _1a3b18uv _4fpr8stv _5goinqa1 _f8pj13af _9oik18uv _1bnxglyw _jf4cnqa1 _30l313af _1nrm18uv _c2waglyw _1iohnqa1 _9h8h12zz _10531ra0 _1ien1ra0 _n0fx1ra0 _1vhv17z1" href="http://careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness" data-renderer-mark="true" data-is-router-link="false" data-testid="link-with-safety"><em data-renderer-mark="true">careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness</em></a><em data-renderer-mark="true">.</em></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Engineering Manager – Server-Driven UI (Codeless)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the role</h2> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Codeless, our internal Server-Driven UI (SDUI) platform team. In this role, you will lead a cross-functional team bridging mobile/web frontend engineering and core platform backend systems.</p> <p>While this role is deeply rooted in modern UI architecture, its mission goes beyond standard UI development: Codeless empowers product teams across the organization to ship dynamic, native UI experiences dynamically from the backend—eliminating app store release bottlenecks, dramatically accelerating feature iteration, and establishing a unified UI schema across iOS, Android, and Web.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing</h2> <p>This is a role with broad impact, from hands-on technical guidance to championing web and mobile accessibility across the company. We're looking for a leader who excels at fostering collaboration and can confidently guide a concept from initial idea to robust implementation.</p> <h3><strong>Day-to-day in this role you’ll:</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Team Leadership & Strategy: </strong>Build, mentor, and scale an engineering team responsible for our core Server-Driven UI platform ("Codeless"). Foster an inclusive, high-ownership engineering culture.</li> <li><strong>Platform Architecture & Evolution:</strong> Oversee the design and evolution of dynamic layout engines, declarative UI schemas, and client rendering frameworks across iOS, Android, and Web.</li> <li><strong>Developer Velocity & Platform Adoption:</strong> Partner with product feature teams to drive internal adoption of Codeless. Ensure the platform provides exceptional Developer Experience, clear tooling, robust design system integration, and seamless debugging workflows.</li> <li><strong>Technical Execution & Quality:</strong> Set high technical standards for platform performance, payload optimization, caching strategies, backward compatibility, and graceful offline/fallback behavior across client devices.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Work closely with Product Managers, Design System leaders, and Core Infrastructure engineers to align the Codeless roadmap with broader company initiatives and global design paradigms.</li> </ul> <h2>What you’ll need to thrive</h2> <p><strong>Engineering Management:</strong> 3+ years of experience managing software engineering teams, with a track record of coaching engineers, delivering complex platform initiatives, and driving technical strategy.</p> <p><strong>UI & Platform Domain Expertise:</strong> Strong foundational background in mobile (iOS/Android) or modern web architecture (React, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, or declarative UI paradigms).</p> <p><strong>Product & Platform Mindset: </strong>Ability to treat internal product engineering teams as customers, evaluating platform success through developer velocity, adoption metrics, and rendering performance.</p> <h2>Why join us</h2> <p>At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters—solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:</p> <p>🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.</p> <p>🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.</p> <p>🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.</p> <p>🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.</p> <p>💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.</p> <p>➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.</p> <p>We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.</p></div><p><strong>ABOUT THE TEAM</strong><br>The UK Growth team owns how Anduril builds and converts opportunity in the UK, from market engagement and capture through to contract. We draw on business lines, legal, finance, engineering, programme management expertise from across Anduril to turn capability into contracts. There is no dedicated commercial function in the UK today. This role is the first of its kind, sitting within Growth, and the person in this seat will shape Anduril UK’s commercial approach.<br><br><strong>ABOUT THE JOB</strong><br>We are looking for a Commercial Officer to join our rapidly growing team in London. You will own and drive the commercial strategy for Anduril's UK defence business, operating at the intersection of strategy, business development, and deal execution. You will help build and manage a pipeline of government and defence contracts, structure and negotiate deals, and make sure Anduril captures and delivers on opportunities across the MOD.<br><br>This role demands breadth. You will engage at senior levels with military leaders, government officials, and industry partners, and you will also roll up your sleeves on contract negotiation, pricing, and bid strategy. Anduril's UK presence is scaling fast and established playbooks for all scenarios do not yet exist, so you must be comfortable with ambiguity and willing to build process where none exists.<br><br><strong>WHAT YOU'LL DO</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and execute Anduril's commercial strategy for the UK defence market, aligned with the company's growth objectives.</li> <li>Work with the wider Business Development team to win opportunities across UK government procurement programmes, direct contracts, and partnership-led bids.</li> <li>Develop pricing and margin strategy in coordination with business lines and Global Defence, balancing competitiveness with business sustainability.</li> <li>Lead deal structuring, negotiation, and close on major defence contracts, including government-to-government, prime-sub, and teaming arrangements.</li> <li>Own the commercial terms of bids and proposals, ensuring alignment with MOD procurement frameworks (e.g. DEFCON, SSRO regulations).</li> <li>Manage commercial risk across the portfolio, including export control compliance (ITAR/EAR), offset/industrial participation obligations, and sovereign requirements.</li> <li>Serve as the primary commercial interface with MOD Commercial and Defence Procurement</li> <li>Build and sustain relationships at senior levels across UK MOD, the NADG, and Front Line Commands.</li> <li>Represent Anduril at industry events, defence exhibitions, and government engagements as a credible commercial voice.</li> <li>Work closely with Anduril's US-based commercial and legal teams to align UK deal structures with corporate standards.</li> <li>Build the UK commercial function from the ground up – hiring, process, negotiating, deal structuring</li> <li>Establish commercial governance frameworks appropriate for a scaling defence business, including approval authorities, contract review processes, and pipeline reporting.</li> <li>Act as player-coach: personally leading on marquee pursuits, and, when scale dictates, mobilise and develop a team to handle the growing pipeline.</li> <li>Navigate ambiguity and define your own path – the UK operation is scaling rapidly, and established playbooks may not exist yet.</li> </ul> <p><strong>REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>10+ years of progressive commercial experience in UK defence, with a track record of winning and delivering government contracts.</li> <li>Deep understanding of UK MOD procurement, including DEFCON terms, Single Source regulations, and National Armaments Director Group acquisition processes.</li> <li>Proven ability to structure and negotiate complex defence deals, including teaming agreements, subcontracts, and government primes.</li> <li>Experience managing export control and technology transfer requirements, including ITAR, EAR, and UK OGEL/SIEL frameworks.</li> <li>Credible engaging at SCS2 level and above with senior military and government stakeholders.</li> <li>Strong commercial judgement, able to balance risk, margin, and strategic value in deal decisions.</li> <li>Comfort working across a diverse range of disciplines including design, engineering, programme management, legal and contracts, supply chain, and finance.</li> <li>Ability to be local to or relocate to London, UK.</li> <li>SC cleared and eligible to obtain and maintain DV clearance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in autonomous systems or advanced defence technology programmes.</li> <li>Familiarity with US defence contracting norms and FMS/DCS frameworks, enabling effective coordination with Anduril's US headquarters.</li> <li>Experience building a commercial function in a high-growth or start-up environment.</li> <li>Background in or exposure to industrial participation, offset, SSRO, innovative commercial deal structuring and sovereign capability development programmes.</li> </ul><div title: Senior People Business Partner
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Mixpanel</strong></p> <p>Mixpanel is the leading product intelligence and analytics platform, trusted by more than 29,000 companies to help understand how people use the products they build. By combining powerful analytics with AI that knows your business, Mixpanel helps teams see what’s working, diagnose what’s not, and decide what to build next. Learn more at <a href="https://mixpanel.com/home/">mixpanel.com</a>.</p></div><p><strong>About the People and Culture Team</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>The Mixpanel People team exists to help every employee do their best work. We build the structure and support that enables a high-performing organization to move fast without losing what makes us Mixpanel - connection, candor, and the values we hold each other to.</p> <p>A core driver of Mixpanel's success is investing in our people and clearing the way for individuals and teams of every background to reach their full potential. The People function leads that work - executing our people strategy, advising senior leadership, and running HR operations with the rigor a high-performing company demands.</p> <p>Within that team, this role owns the EMEA go-to-market population specifically — three offices (London, Barcelona, and Tel Aviv) growing fast enough that the programs supporting them are still being built, not just maintained.</p> <p><strong>About the Role</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <p>This is a hybrid role based in London, supporting Mixpanel's EMEA business across our London, Barcelona, and Israel offices, embedded with our Go-To-Market leadership team. You'll report to our Global Head of HR Business Partners and operate as a strategic, trusted advisor to EMEA GTM leadership - shaping programs and policy, not just executing them.</p> <p>This is a multi-country role by design. Your GTM population sits across the UK, Spain, and Israel, so working knowledge of employment law and practice in all three is essential - the right call in one market is often the wrong call in another. Experience supporting teams in APAC is a strong plus as our footprint there grows, but it isn't required.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the primary People Business Partner for Mixpanel's EMEA GTM leadership team, operating as a strategic, trusted advisor on org design, workforce planning, and talent strategy.</li> <li>Proactively coach and partner with GTM people managers and leaders across EMEA to build, lead, and grow high-performing teams.</li> <li>Lead complex, multi-country change initiatives — reorgs, comp cycles, policy rollouts — from strategy through communication, partnering with stakeholders to build buy-in rather than just announcing outcomes.</li> <li>Investigate and resolve employee relations matters across the UK, Spain, and Israel, balancing legal risk, company principle, and individual dignity.</li> <li>Turn workforce data — attrition, engagement, performance — into a business case leaders act on, not just a report they skim.</li> <li>Collaborate with the broader People team on programs that elevate the employee experience company-wide, bringing an EMEA- and GTM-specific point of view to global design.</li> <li>Maintain fluency in HR principles, practices, and regulatory environments across the UK, Spain, and Israel to recommend policy with confidence.</li> <li>Build automation and AI into your own workflows and the team's — using it to move faster on the transactional work so there's more time for the judgment calls that need a person.</li> </ul> <p><strong>We're Looking For Someone Who Has</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of experience in HR/People roles, including 5+ years as a dedicated People/HR Business Partner, ideally supporting Sales or go-to-market organizations.</li> <li>Working knowledge of employment law and HR practice in the UK, Spain, & Israel — experience in all 3 regions preferred but required in UK & Spain.</li> <li>Deep functional experience in two or more HR areas: talent management, employee relations, employee experience, compensation, organizational development, or HR policy.</li> <li>A track record of leading through ambiguity and owning multi-country problems end to end.</li> <li>Strong analytical and project management skills, with sound commercial judgment and empathy in equal measure.</li> <li>Fluency with AI and automation tools, and a habit of using them to create efficiency in your own work rather than waiting for someone else to build the solution.</li> <li>Excellent, direct communication — the kind that earns trust even in hard conversations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience supporting APAC teams or navigating employment practice in other European markets.</li> </ul> <p>#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Benefits and Perks</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care</li> <li>Mental Wellness Benefit</li> <li>Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays</li> <li>Enhanced Parental Leave</li> <li>Volunteer Time Off</li> <li>Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break</li> </ul> <p><em>*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*</em></p> <p><strong>Culture Values</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Make Bold Bets:</strong> We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.</li> <li><strong>Innovate with Insight:</strong> We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>One Team:</strong> We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.</li> <li><strong>Candor with Connection:</strong> We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.</li> <li><strong>Champion the Customer:</strong> We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.</li> <li><strong>Powerful Simplicity:</strong> We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why choose Mixpanel?</strong></p> <p>We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.</p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h2>About the AI Security Institute</h2> <p>The AI Security Institute is the world's largest and best-funded team dedicated to understanding advanced AI risks and translating that knowledge into action. We’re in the heart of the UK government with direct lines to No. 10 (the Prime Minister's office), and we work with frontier developers and governments globally.</p> <p>We’re here because governments are critical for advanced AI going well, and UK AISI is uniquely positioned to mobilise them. With our resources, unique agility and international influence, this is the best place to shape both AI development and government action.</p></div><h2><strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">Team Description </span></span></strong><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2"> </span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134245418":true,"134245529":true,"335557856":16777215,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></h2> <p><span data-contrast="none">Risks from misaligned AI systems are growing increasingly important as AI systems become more capable, autonomous, and integrated into society. Understanding these risks and stress-testing mitigations is crucial to ensuring advanced AI systems are developed and deployed safely and beneficially in the future.</span> <br> <br><span data-contrast="none">The Alignment Red Team is a specialised subteam within AISI's wider Red Team focused on detecting and evaluating misalignment in frontier AI systems. We perform novel research to develop techniques for finding misalignment, and pre- and post-deployment evaluations of frontier AI systems to understand loss-of-control risks associated with models, such as deceptive alignment, research sabotage, and reward-seeking. We share our findings with frontier AI companies and the UK and allied governments, to inform their respective deployments, research, and policy-making. We also work directly with safety teams at frontier labs, sharing our evaluation findings to help improve their model alignment training and monitoring methodology.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"335557856":16777215,"335559738":240,"335559739":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="none">We have conducted pre-deployment testing with multiple frontier AI companies for propensities related to </span><a href="https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/evaluating-whether-ai-models-would-sabotage-ai-safety-research"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">research sabotage</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto">, </span><a href="https://www.aisi.gov.uk/blog/cheating-behaviour-in-frontier-model-evaluations"><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-charstyle="Hyperlink">cheating</span></span></a><span data-contrast="auto"> and <a href="https://deploymentsafety.openai.com/gpt-6-astra/external-evaluations-for-alignment-uk-aisi">unsanctioned cyber-attacks</a>. description: WHO WE ARE At Trustly, we're building a smarter, faster, and more secure financial future by revolutionizing the world of payments. Our Ambition: To build the world’s most disruptive payment network and redefine what the payment experience should feel like. Trustly is a global team of innovators, collaborators, and doers. title: Senior Returns Manager, EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>ABOUT QUINCE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.</p> <p>What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.</p> <p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>OUR CULTURE</strong></span></p> <p>Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.</p> <ul> <li>We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA.  Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.</li> <li>Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths. </li> <li>Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory. </li> </ul> <p>If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.</p></div><h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We're looking for a Returns Manager to own end-to-end reverse logistics performance across our UK and EU operations. From forecasting incoming volume through grading, refunds, fraud prevention, and resale, you'll build a returns operation that's fast, accurate, and cost-efficient — while turning returned inventory back into recovered value. This is a hands-on role for someone who can dig into root causes, manage partners and carriers, and build the reporting to prove it's working.</p> <h2>What You'll Do</h2> <p><strong>Returns Forecasting & Planning</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain returns volume forecasting models across UK and EU markets, factoring in seasonality, backlog, promotions, and category-level return patterns</li> <li>Translate forecasts into staffing, processing capacity, and warehouse space plans for returns operations</li> <li>Monitor returns rate trends and flag volume shifts to inventory, finance, and merchandising teams</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"> </p> <p><strong>Customer Refunds</strong></p> <ul> <li>Oversee and finance to resolve refund discrepancies and disputes</li> <li>Track refund turnaround time against SLA and resolve bottlenecks in the refund workflow</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"> </p> <p><strong>Fraud Detection & Prevention</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and refine fraud detection processes for returns abuse (wardrobing, fraud prevention with customer experience, avoiding over-blocking of legitimate returns</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"> </p> clearance, secondary market and liquidation partners)</li> <li>Maximize recovery value on returned inventory while minimizing time-to-resale</li> <li>Build and manage relationships with resale/liquidation partners and evaluate new recommerce channels across UK and EU markets</li> </ul> <p data-renderer-start-pos="2290" data-local-id="6a0d0d38-3057-4834-9012-12f09f19e465"> </p> title: Product Manager
description: About us People assume the supply chain is an automated, algorithmic system. In reality, hundred of thousands of operators acting as the glue between organisations and systems, doing work the world depends on, with tools that have barely changed in decades and spending hours a day on email. Nexcade is building the agentic operating system for those people, transforming the way people communicate and optimise the $1T spend on logistics every year. Our agents are live in production with leading global Freight Forwarders, pricing millions in freight every week, and we are rapidly expanding the platform to touch every part of the logistics lifecycle. Our founders, Dan and Tasho, spent years at Sedna and Palantir working with supply chain companies on problems like this one. We have raised $8.5M to make this a reality from top VCs and angels who backed or founded Synthesia, n8n and other world-class companies. How we work Everybody builds, founders included. The whole company is technical and runs on coding agents. You will not be asked to write production software, but you will use agents for discovery synthesis, specs, prototypes and data analysis rather than doing them by hand. Closely with customers and design partners, so what we ship changes how they operate. At pace. Fast cycles and quick iterations, on the product and on how we work. End to end. If you see something broken or missing, you have the freedom (and the responsibility) to fix it. In person, in London. We value synchronous communication. Debate rigorously, decide quickly, execute relentlessly. Enjoy the journey. Hard problems, good colleagues. The role We’re building the AI platform freight forwarders rely on. We started with quoting and are expanding across the shipment lifecycle. As Product Lead, you will be central to that expansion, helping decide where we focus and turning those decisions into products customers depend on. What you’ll do: Own product outcomes: Own the roadmap, priorities and performance of specific products, from defining the customer problem through launch, rollout and adoption. Partner with the founders on overall product direction and strategy. Build from customer insight: Work closely with freight forwarders across commercial and operational roles. Understand how they work, identify the problems customers share and build products for those needs rather than one-off solutions. Prototype and build: Turn ideas into working prototypes and early product versions, using AI tools and code to test them with customers. Work hands-on with engineering to take promising ideas into production, not just write specs and hand them over. Drive product expansion: Build a clear view of the market, including where we win, where we do not compete and why customers choose us. Use that understanding to identify the next workflows Nexcade should enter and turn them into products that grow revenue. Raise the standard of product thinking: Define success measures, test assumptions and examine accuracy, edge cases and second-order effects before scaling. Write clear specs and decision documents, including a written recommendation on the hard calls. Build the product operating system: Establish a clear planning and decision-making cadence without adding bureaucracy. Make sure product meetings are well prepared, teams have the context they need and decisions translate into shipped work. Make product and platform trade-offs: Work closely with engineering to decide when to invest in shared capabilities and when a faster, product-specific approach is right. What we look for Strong product judgement: You have owned meaningful product work in a complex B2B product and can show how your decisions changed customer behaviour or business results. You define success clearly and test assumptions, accuracy and edge cases before scaling. Product taste: You can turn complex workflows into products that feel simple, coherent and trustworthy. You care about the details that make people choose to use them. Technical fluency: You work effectively with strong engineers, understand trade-offs across architecture, AI, data and integrations and bring the customer and product perspective to choices about speed, quality and reuse. Excellent judgement: You get beyond what customers ask for to understand how their work really happens and distinguish repeatable needs from bespoke requests. You use customer and market insight to make product choices that drive adoption, expansion and revenue. High agency and directness: You take ownership, hold a high bar and disagree openly and constructively. You are comfortable with ambiguity, fast iteration and changing priorities. Obsess over the problem: You are drawn to complex, messy problems in industries the economy depends on and want to understand how the people and systems behind them really work. Industry experience is a bonus, but not required. Why join The biggest product choices are still ahead: how deep we go, where we expand and how everything fits together. Our product is already live with leading freight forwarders and this role will shape what comes next. You will build AI for the work that keeps global trade moving, alongside a team from Palantir, Raft, Faculty, UnlikelyAI and Oxford. You will get meaningful equity in the company you help build. title: Associate Implementation Consultant
description: Unleash AI Innovators, Securely Software is being rewritten in real time. AI agents are starting to write more code than humans do, at a speed no security team has ever had to match, and that single shift is opening up the biggest opportunity our industry has seen in a decade. We're not bracing for it, we're building the company that owns it. Snyk is building the next generation security platform where security isn't a set of tools people operate. It's a team of security agents working alongside your engineers, finding, fixing, and governing risk at the speed software is now built. These agents work alongside both the company build and the agents they adopt. Security stops being a queue of work waiting for people, and becomes a coordinated workforce companies direct and trust. Job Summary Snyk is hiring an Associate Implementation Consultant to help enterprise customers get started with the Snyk platform after the sale. You will support and deliver onboarding engagements, working with customer development and security teams to configure Snyk across their SDLC, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure. This is an early-career role for someone with a technical foundation who wants to build a career in customer-facing application security, with hands-on work from your first weeks and structured coaching from experienced consultants along the way. About the Team The Customer Solutions team owns the technical success of Snyk's customers after the deal closes, from first onboarding session through full platform adoption. Implementation Consultants work alongside Technical Success, Support, Sales, and Product to turn a customer's security goals into a deployed, measurable program. As Snyk's install base continues to grow, this team is expanding to keep delivering a world-class onboarding experience at scale. What You’ll Do Deliver onboarding engagements for customers with well-defined requirements, following Snyk's onboarding methodology from kick-off through closure. Support senior consultants on larger and more complex implementations, taking ownership of defined workstreams and learning how enterprise rollouts are planned and run. Configure and integrate the Snyk platform with customer source control, CI/CD, container, and cloud environments, working from documented procedures and escalating questions early. Join customer kick-offs, working sessions, and status reviews, and keep customer contacts informed on progress and next steps. Answer customer questions about how Snyk works, and bring in senior consultants, Support, or Product when an issue needs deeper expertise. Keep accurate project plans, notes, and handoff documentation so every engagement is easy for others to pick up. Use Snyk's onboarding playbooks and templates, and suggest improvements when you find gaps. Troubleshoot common integration and configuration issues, and document what you learn for the rest of the team. title: Linux Desktop Support Engineer (London UK office)

Canonical solutions.</p> <p>Location: Office Based in London, England.</p> <h2><strong>The role entails</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Empathetic Engagement:</strong> Partner directly with customers across remote sessions, ticketing,, and live conversations to deeply understand and resolve their technical roadblocks.</li> <li><strong>Collaborative Problem Solving:</strong> Work hand-in-hand with internal engineering teams and regional peer groups to bridge the gap between complex code fixes and real-world customer satisfaction.</li> <li><strong>True Ownership:</strong> Manage your support cases with a strong sense of personal integrity, ensuring commitments are honored and customer expectations are communicated transparently and predictably.</li> <li><strong>Ubuntu Lifecycle Guidance:</strong> Develop a rich understanding of the Ubuntu development process, empowering you to give customers clear, human context regarding timelines for engineering fixes.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge Advocacy:</strong> Author and maintain accessible knowledge base articles, ensuring lessons learned are shared openly to elevate the entire open-source community.</li> <li><strong>Operational Reliability:</strong> Participate in a regular weekend working rotation to maintain seamless, high-touch continuity of care for our global partners.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What are we looking for in you</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Communication Excellence:</strong> Exceptional written and spoken English, with a natural ability to convey technical complexity clearly, warmly, and compellingly.</li> <li><strong>The Soft-Skill Edge:</strong> A genuine passion for helping people, paired with the emotional intelligence to navigate high-stakes technical situations with composure and empathy.</li> <li><strong>Academic Dedication:</strong> Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university.</li> <li><strong>Educational Background:</strong> An undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path.</li> <li><strong>On-Site Technical Leadership:</strong> Based in our state-of-the-art London, UK office, you will serve as a key technical support resource for our local teams and employees.</li> <li><strong>Driven Mindset:</strong> A proven track record of going above-and-beyond expectations to deliver meaningful, outstanding results for teams or customers.</li> <li><strong>Linux & Cloud Familiarity:</strong> Practical, hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, with an exposure to three or more of the following:</li> <ul> <li><em>Virtualization & Cloud:</em> Using KVM or OpenStack.</li> <li><em>Containers:</em> primarily Docker, LXD/LXC, or Kubernetes.</li> <li><em>Storage Ecosystems:</em> Block, object, and network storage technologies.</li> <li><em>System Networking:</em> Navigating bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, or MTU tuning.</li> </ul> <li><strong>Analytical Curiosity:</strong> A strong troubleshooting mindset—the ability to look into stack traces or logs, identify OS/application-level bugs, and strategically guide the customer through next steps.</li> <li><strong>Development Fundamentals:</strong> Basic programming logic in any language to help parse code and collaborate effectively with Canonical Engineering teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></h2> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year</li> <li>Annual compensation review</li> <li>Recognition rewards</li> <li>Annual holiday leave</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave</li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues</li> <li>Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events</li> </ul> <h3><strong>About Canonical</strong></h3> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products.<a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity"> Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Support Engineer
description: <p>Accelerate your technical career by joining Canonical in a high-impact, multi-disciplinary role.. You'll be working from our London office, which hosts our events, customer demos and visitors, in an event space with professional live video, audio and streaming equipment. You'll wear three hats: Linux and cloud support engineer, owner of the office's technical infrastructure, and one of the people running the live production at our events. You'll own your cases from first contact to resolution, bringing in colleagues or senior engineers when needed, and you'll keep the technology running when it matters most, with people watching. While professional broadcast or AV experience is not required, a strong technical curiosity for audio/video systems and the composure to manage live, high-stakes environments are a must.</p> <p>Location: Office Based in London, England.</p> <p><strong>The role entails</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Office technology:</strong> Own the technical state of the London office (network, devices, meeting spaces, AV), including onboarding new colleagues, and know how it all fits together.</li> <li><strong>Live events:</strong> Run the technology for events and customer demos, from set-up and live operation through to tear-down, and coordinate external crew for larger events.</li> <li><strong>Customer support:</strong> Own your cases end to end, working with customers by ticket, remote session and live conversation, and with engineering teams to turn code fixes into customer outcomes. Set clear expectations and keep your commitments.</li> <li><strong>Ubuntu lifecycle:</strong> Understand the Ubuntu development process well enough to give customers realistic timelines for fixes.</li> <li><strong>Knowledge:</strong> Write and maintain knowledge base articles so lessons learned are shared.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What are we looking for in you</strong></p> <ul> <li>Exceptional written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical complexity clearly and warmly</li> <li>An exceptional academic record at high school and university, with an undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative path</li> <li>A builder's streak: something you've set up or run for other people on a deadline, such as a home lab, hackspace, student tech crew, live sound, streaming, or school or club IT</li> <li>AV curiosity: real interest in audio, video and live production, or a clear appetite to learn it </li> <li>Composure and care: you like helping people and stay calm when a high-stakes moment, including a live event, gets tense</li> <li>A track record of going above and beyond for teams or customers</li> <li>Hands-on experience supporting Linux systems, plus any of: virtualization or cloud (KVM, OpenStack), containers (Docker, LXD/LXC, Kubernetes), storage (block, object, network), or networking (bonding, firewalls, bridging, switching, MTU tuning)</li> <li>A troubleshooting mindset (logs, stack traces, OS and application-level causes) and programming fundamentals in any language</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we offer colleagues</strong></p> <p>We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We assess performance and revisit compensation twice annually to ensure we recognize outstanding colleagues. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.</p> <ul> <li>Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person.</li> <li>Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year.</li> <li>Bi-annual compensation review.</li> <li>Company recognition rewards.</li> <li>40 days annual leave per annum, including public holidays and our All Company holiday periods.</li> <li>Maternity and paternity leave.</li> <li>Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform.</li> <li>Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues, with Priority Pass for lounge access.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Canonical</strong></p> <p>Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. We are founder-led, profitable, and growing.</p> <p>Powered by worldwide distributed collaboration since our inception in 2004, we believe tech and business leadership can emerge anywhere. We have no central headquarters. Most of us work from home, but we are exceptionally disciplined about this. We have very high expectations of all colleagues, and are champions of excellence. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.</p> <p><strong>Canonical is an equal opportunity employer</strong></p> <p>We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. <a href="https://canonical.com/careers/diversity/identity">Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.</a></p>

title: Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;">Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.</span></p></div><p><strong>The Community You Will Join</strong></p> <p>The Cities team leads the work necessary to implement the regulatory products and processes needed globally to comply with regulations, and does so in a manner that also sustainably supports Airbnb's growth.</p> <p>Within Cities, this role owns Airbnb's platform regulatory compliance program across EMEA — the growing set of EU and UK obligations that sit alongside, and increasingly beyond, short-term rental regulation.</p> <p><strong>The Difference You Will Make</strong></p> <p>As Senior Compliance Lead, EMEA, you are the accountable owner for a portfolio of platform regulations that is expanding in scope, scrutiny, and consequence — including the Digital Services Act, the UK Online Safety Act, and more.</p> <p>You will translate each obligation into a durable operating process, a defensible reporting methodology, or a product change — and serve as a trusted advisor to Legal, Policy, and Product leadership on how Airbnb meets its regulatory commitments in the region.</p> <p><strong>A Typical Day: </strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Own the EMEA compliance portfolio.</strong> Establish the operating processes and documentation that sustain obligations at scale, and report and monitor status and risk.</li> <li><strong>Deliver regulatory reporting and submissions.</strong> Own the annual and ad hoc reporting calendar end to end. Deliver against regulatory deadlines, and iterate so each cycle is faster and more defensible than the last.</li> <li><strong>Assess obligations and strengthen assurance.</strong> Identify new and changing obligations early, evaluate our readiness against them, and recommend the measures required to meet them. </li> <li><strong>Translate regulatory requirements into scalable solutions. </strong>Define the product, engineering, and data requirements needed to meet obligations at scale, and partner with Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap, sequence delivery, and validate outcomes against compliance standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Your Expertise: </strong></p> <ul> <li>12+ years of experience in regulatory compliance, compliance program management, or regulatory operations — preferably in a technology platform or another highly regulated industry.</li> <li>Proven track record owning a multi-jurisdiction, cross-functional compliance program end to end, with direct experience across the Digital Services Act, and the UK Online Safety Act. </li> <li>Hands-on experience with a recurring regulator-facing reporting cycle and the relationship management that comes with it.</li> <li>Track record partnering with Product and Engineering to deliver regulatory requirements into live products.</li> <li>Data fluency to define, own, and defend a reporting methodology to auditors and regulators.</li> <li>Familiarity with regulatory technology and automation tools.</li> <li>Ability to operate with a strategic lens—connecting regulatory requirements to long-term business objectives and functional roadmaps.</li> <li>Excellent communicator and negotiator; able to transform ambiguity into clarity, and move from complexity to consensus.</li> <li>Strong analytical skills and an ability to design operational structures that balance compliance, risk, and scalability.</li> <li>Proven leadership growing and coaching high-performing, diverse teams; comfortable leading through influence as well as structure.</li> </ul> <p><strong style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif;">Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: #000000;">Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.</span></p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><span style="font-size: 16px;"><strong><span style="font-family: arial, helvetica, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 0, 0);">How We'll Take Care of You:</span></strong></span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 16px;">Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.</span></p></div><div class="title">United Kingdom Annual Pay Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£122,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>£152,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p> </p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Reasonable Accommodations:</strong> We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12pt;"><strong>A Note on Recruiting Scams:</strong> Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @<a href="http://airbnb.com">airbnb.com</a> or @<a href="http://ext.airbnb.com">ext.airbnb.com</a> email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing.  We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.</span></p> <p> </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Principal Analyst (MMM)
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About WPP</strong></p> <p>Gain Theory is part of<span class="Apple-converted-space"> </span><a href="https://urldefense.com/v3/__http:/wpp.com/__;!!IfJP2Nwhk5Z0yJ43lA!L_cfT4E3gsmmDY1lVQTB6ihlfPeBl9X4sMM2KI6iWZYexC2nCeZ9oxgP9qvgbrqxIBpx82rGb_mWqh5F0zKxq5_dP7Y$" data-outlook-id="5677231c-455b-4705-9250-42d6515234fb">WPP</a>, the trusted growth partner for the world's leading brands. Powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform WPP Open, WPP unites cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, creativity, production, enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel. </p></div><h2>The opportunity:</h2> <p>You will support senior colleagues in achieving the efficient delivery of client projects. Typical responsibilities and duties are the collection and preparation of data, contributing to the finalisation of models, writing results and implications and SFX creation.</p> <p>Your role as Principal Analyst is to take responsibility for and oversee other analysts. You will also be expected support the development of analysts through the Training Academy, Knowledge Shares and feedback. Principal Analysts should develop relationships with their counterparts client side and be able to communicate Gain Theory approaches and brand beliefs.</p> <h2>What you’ll be doing:</h2> <p><strong><em>Working with data:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Data extraction and manipulation, data analysis and validation, batch files, programming</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Undertake data extraction, manipulation, and data analysis to understand the marketplace and client context relevant to each project.</em></li> <li><em>Analyse all datasets to ensure that each KPI is understood and can be explained back to the team.</em></li> <li><em>Ensure that all tables, charts and other information produced by you, or others has been checked for accuracy and formatted to GT standards before passing on to senior project team.</em></li> <li><em>Be responsible for data collection including preparation and sending of data requests, chasing outstanding data and querying data with clients and agencies.</em></li> <li><em>Ensure that ROVA input files are structured to meet requirements of project (e.g. order and number of variables, exclusion of unnecessary variables)</em></li> <li><em>Ensure that all outputs are checked for accuracy by analysts; record any checks made.</em></li> <li><em>Proficiency in using data extraction tools (i.e. Advantage, AdDynamix, Sysomos, Google Trends, Google Analytics, Double Click) and able to teach others in their use. Be aware of alternatives and the PROs / CONs of the tool.</em></li> <li><em>Proficiency in using Excel/SQL/Python/Pandas/Analytics Workbench to process, transform, create variables and build models. Be or be working towards expert knowledge in a selection of these tools / approaches.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Building Models:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Model building and validation, sales effects calculations, ROIs, media optimisation</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Oversee the building of comprehensive base models according to the project specification, incorporating all drivers of KPIs, providing rationale for variables entered, understanding coefficients and SFX.</em></li> <li><em>Taking base models, oversee or build in additional improvements and progress the model towards finalization.</em></li> <li><em>Calculate sales effects throughout the project to check results and assess their correctness, i.e. does media contribution make sense? Report to project team on preliminary findings and observations</em></li> <li><em>Create sales effect/ ROI workbook, ensure it is easy to follow and all links are correct.</em></li> <li><em>Create response curves and optimisation spreadsheets or alternatively use available tools for budget allocation. Run scenarios required to answer client objectives.</em></li> <li><em>Validate models, identify areas of weakness, suggest and test possible improvements and ensure robustness and validity.</em></li> </ul> <p><em>.</em><strong><em>Creation of presentations:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Content creation, summary of findings, accuracy checks</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Create content as specified by project lead, taking responsibility for entire sections rather than focusing on just factual and data slides.</em></li> <li><em>Assist in the creation of all areas of the deck as directed.</em></li> <li><em>Ensure that all content is checked for accuracy and that it is correctly labelled, complete and ready for delivery to client.</em></li> <li><em>Summarise and comment on findings, add consultancy input rather than on factual statements.</em></li> <li><em>Be able to explain and justify any potential changes that need to be made to provide sensible results. Especially important when reviewing others’ outputs that you are overseeing.</em></li> </ul> <p><em> </em><strong><em>Client Relationship Management & Interaction:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Client contact and interaction, delivery of results to the client</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Answer specific data questions that may arise in external meetings as the lead analyst; act as a specialist closest to the data.</em></li> <li><em>Be prepared to lead calls with clients (data calls, weekly calls etc.).</em></li> <li><em>Be involved in the delivery of results to the client and present sections of presentations during meetings.</em></li> <li><em>Take charge of day-to-day client contact using email and telephone where appropriate.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong><em> </em></strong><strong><em>Interpretation of results:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Result interpretation and rationale, recommendations, translation of results from analytics into actionable recommendations</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Provide input into the results and implications and comment on the interpretation for future strategies.</em></li> <li><em>Interpret results and understand the implications of these results to the client. Be able to explain your interpretation to the team and defend your POV.</em></li> <li><em>Be able to explain and justify any potential changes that need to be made to provide sensible results. Especially important when reviewing others’ outputs that you are overseeing.</em></li> </ul> <p><em> </em><strong><em>Team Support & Development:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Team collaboration, leadership, communication</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Motivate and inspire team members by ensuring that excellent performance is acknowledged and reasons for success are shared amongst the team.</em></li> <li><em>Take responsibility for supervising, supporting and training junior team members.</em></li> <li><em>Take responsibility for training new joiners including project managing Graduate Analysts during their training project.</em></li> <li><em>Lead by behaving in a way that reinforces values and goals of Gain Theory to all employees.</em></li> <li><em>Assist team members in interpreting the tasks they have been set.</em></li> <li><em>Provide timely feedback to team members.</em></li> </ul> <p><strong><em>Innovation:</em></strong><em> </em><em>Process improvements, product development, new trainings</em></p> <ul> <li><em>Actively seek more efficient ways of doing things for yourself and others and turn suggestions into actions.</em></li> <li><em>Host knowledge shares to share your experience on topics of interest for the business.</em></li> <li><em>Be proactive in using new tools and take the active part in their testing when in the development stage, in line with your personal expertise and skills.</em></li> <li><em>Assist in service and product development, where necessary. Actively put yourself forward if your involvement can improve outcomes for the company.</em></li> </ul> <h2>What we want from you:</h2> <ul> <li><em>2-3 years of experience in an analytical role, other advanced techniques.</em></li> <li><em>You can work within an inclusive and diverse team to deliver fresh thinking and innovative solutions.  </em></li> <li><em>You interact with colleagues and title: Quality Assurance Manager
description: PHMG works with more than 36,000 clients across the globe – and we're committed to delivering the very best service to every single one. This dedication to has led to the rapid expansion of our client care teams, as we continue to expand our impact, we are seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Quality Assurance Manager. As a Quality Assurance Manager, you will assist in the management of the quality assurance team providing coaching, leadership and guidance, whilst also overseeing the development and delivery of a robust internal audit function that delivers value and best practice to the internal governance of the business. The Quality Assurance Team play a crucial role within the Client Services department. You will be responsible for reviewing all engagement with our client base, reporting effectively on processes, analysing the data and trends to ensure that quality standards are consistently met across projects and departments and identifying and implementing relevant process improvements. Salary: £34,000 base (£39,000 OTE) Location: Old Trafford, Manchester Hours: Monday to Friday 8.45am to 5.15pm Job Role As a Quality Assurance Manager, you will oversee the development and delivery of a robust internal audit function that delivers value and best practice to the internal governance of the business. The Quality Assurance Team play a crucial role within the Client Services department. title: Senior Specialist, QA
description: <div class="content-intro"><p></p> <p><strong>About Summit:</strong></p> <p>Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.</p> <p>Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:</p> <p><strong>Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Colorectal Cancer (CRC)</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.</p> </li> </ul> <p><em>Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.</em></p> <p></p></div><p><strong><span data-contrast="none">Overview of Role:</span></strong><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335557856":16777215,"335559739":240,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Senior Specialist, QA will provide operational leadership and quality oversight for the review, approval and release-readiness of clinical and commercial product batches.</span><span data-ccp-props="{"201341983":0,"335551550":6,"335551620":6,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The role is responsible for ensuring that batch documentation is complete, accurate, traceable, and compliant with applicable GMP requirements, approved procedures and regulatory commitments before submission to QA for final disposition or QP certification. title: Data Scientist - Broker Terms
description: Data Scientist - Broker Terms Team Hybrid in London, United Kingdom We're looking for a Data Scientist to join the Broker Terms team. You'll shape the analytical approach for a team that sets the terms on iwoca's biggest acquisition channel. The team is young, with many unexplored opportunities. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they ildrive. The team Broker Terms is a growing team that sits within iwoca's third-party acquisition department. It owns the full offer terms strategy for customers referred through the broker network – both first-time customers and repeat. The team sets pricing, loan amounts, durations, and broker commissions, and owns the UX that presents them to brokers and customers. The team is small and interdisciplinary, combining commercial strategy, engineering, and data science. The work translates business questions into quantitative problems, and findings into actionable decisions. Active projects include: Model-based pricing – creating a sophisticated model to offer bespoke pricing to each customer A no-fee test – examining how our product performs when we remove all drawdown fees, and how that influence customer repayment behaviour Testing longer-duration flexi-loan products with particular customer segments. Reintroductions - exploring the right offer terms to give returning customers The team is small and cross-functional – commercial strategy, engineering, design, and data science – and works across the full application stack, from the Broker API to the Introducer Portal brokers use. The role You'll model expected customer take-up rates, design experiments, and translate findings into pricing and product decisions for the acquisition channel that drives the most customer lifetime value (CLTV). Because the Broker Terms team is a young team, you'll influence how its analytical approach develops, not just what it produces. The work has direct commercial consequences: brokers act on what the team builds and tests, and that shapes which customers iwoca wins and on what terms. Offer terms and experimentation. You'll model how customers respond to offer terms and how brokers make decisions under uncertainty. You'll design experiments where causal inference is central: you'll need to know where standard A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. Commercial translation. You'll work with commercial and strategy colleagues and see your analysis applied directly in day-to-day decisions. That includes meeting brokers in person – gaining context that shapes how you frame and interpret results – and coordinating with adjacent teams responsible for underwriting decisions, repeat lending, and offer construction. CLTV and customer journey. You'll think across the full broker-referred customer journey – from first funding to repeat – identifying what drives CLTV and what changes to offer terms or UX improve it. You own both the strategy and the mechanism, so your findings feed directly into what the team builds and tests. AI and ways of working. You'll use AI to accelerate and automate your analytical work – not occasionally, but as a default. You should have a view on where it genuinely helps and where a different approach is better. The requirements Essential: Statistical foundations. You have a background in probability and statistics from a quantitative field such as mathematics, physics, or statistics. You're comfortable with Bayesian reasoning, and have applied hierarchical models or formal decision-making under uncertainty in real work. Causal inference and experimentation. You've separated signal from noise in observational and experimental data. You know where A/B testing breaks down and what to reach for instead. You have experience with careful experimental design to facilitate clean, trustworthy results. Analytical ownership. You take loosely defined problems from start to finish – framing the question, choosing the method, and landing the answer with the people who act on it. Data tooling. You're proficient with data manipulation and modelling tools, and with scientific computing libraries (pandas, numpy, sklearn, PyMC). AI leverage. You've used AI to produce work you couldn't have delivered without it – an analysis pipeline, a prototype, or a tool others use. You judge where it helps and where it doesn't, and you check its output before anyone acts on it. Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail for non-technical colleagues in commercial and strategy roles. Bonus: Modelling depth. You've built or adapted statistical or ML models and can explain the maths behind them to commercial stakeholders. Stochastic methods. You've used stochastic processes for inference or time-series modelling. Broker market insight. You've worked with brokers or other intermediaries in lending or financial services. The salary We expect to pay from £70,000 to £100,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews. The culture At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective. We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them. The offices We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work: Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks. Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions. The benefits Flexible working hours. Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership. A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents. 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave. A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years. Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support. 3% Pension contributions on total earnings. An employee equity incentive scheme. Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money. Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme. Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield. And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer: A learning and development budget for everyone. Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers. Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.
