title: Applied AI Engineer - Direct Acquisition
description: Applied AI Engineer - Direct Acquisition We're planning this as a six-month secondment. There may be an opportunity to extend it or make it permanent. We're looking for an Applied AI Engineer to join the Direct Acquisition team. You'll design and build AI agents that run whole business processes, from planning the work to learning from the results. What you find will steer how far iwoca takes agents across the business. The company Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don't wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that's as flexible and responsive as they are. That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed. We've already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £5 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive. The team Direct Acquisition includes iwoca's Marketing, Sales, Brand and Acquisition Tech teams. Together, they reach UK businesses of all shapes and sizes through paid and organic marketing channels and direct sales. A new team in Direct Acquisition builds agents that automate and improve acquisition processes. That's its only focus, and it works closely with Acquisition Tech. It's small – a product owner and you – and everyone builds. You'll report to the Head of Direct Acquisition, who sets the commercial direction. The role As the Applied AI Engineer, you'll build the agents and the systems around them. Most of the work is system design and backend engineering. You'll start with direct mail. The first goal is an agent that plans each monthly round, uses iwoca's existing predictive models to build the mailing file, and learns from the results as they come in. The pattern is simple to say and hard to get right: the agent orchestrates, deterministic code does the work, and a human in the loop approves the file before it goes to print. You'll work with the people who run each process to understand the edge cases, and with Core Systems and Compliance on access and controls. The agents don't exist yet, and much is still open: which processes the team takes on, and what the architecture looks like. You'll own those design decisions and write most of the code yourself, much of it with AI coding tools. Some of this won't work, and finding out why is one of the main outputs of the role. Architecture. You'll design what agents need to run reliably: memory that persists between runs, task management, access to tools, permissions, and a record of every decision and why. You'll build each piece so the next process can reuse it. Guardrails. You'll decide where the agent uses judgement and where code enforces rules the agent can't change, like suppressions, compliance checks and budget limits. Delivery. You'll own each agent end to end: connect it to iwoca's predictive models, data pipelines and channel tools, and run it alongside the current process until it has shown it works. Measurement. You'll track how often agents need a person, where they fail, what they cost, and what they're worth. The requirements We're looking for the depth of someone who has solved hard problems, and the pace of someone who moves fast in areas that are new to them. Essential: System ownership. You've owned a complex system end to end, from design to running it in production, and lived with the consequences of your architecture choices. Design judgement. You've made architecture decisions other people built on, and you can explain the trade-offs and what you'd change. When an idea won't work, you say so and offer a better one. Pace. You've got things live quickly in unfamiliar areas and they kept working once people relied on them. Agent engineering. You've built systems where LLMs take actions – more than chat or summaries – and you can explain what went wrong and how you fixed it. title: Research Analyst

Can produce well-structured, accurate, and engaging research reports in fluent English. Understand institutional financial markets and can identify research topics relevant to professional audiences. Have a product mindset and understand how high-quality research can create value for audiences and support commercial opportunities. What we offer to you: 100% remote work with no location restrictions. Flexible working hours with no time tracking and no mandatory meetings outside your timezone. Paid time off to recharge. Direct collaboration with the CEO and executive leadership on research strategy and institutional initiatives. Opportunities to build your personal brand through speaking engagements, podcasts, conferences, and media appearances. Access to major crypto and fintech events around the world. Internal learning programs, masterclasses, and knowledge sharing. Clear goals, measurable outcomes, and a data-driven culture where your work has a visible business impact. An inclusive workplace where everyone, regardless of background, nationality, gender, identity, abilities, or beliefs, can thrive. At BIC, we value your ideas, curiosity, dynamism, adaptability, ownership mindset, passion for innovation and AI, awareness of industry trends, and ability to work autonomously and stay organized. If this approach resonates with you, we’d love to welcome you to our team and achieve new heights together! Engineering, Product and Operations.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>🤩 We’d love to hear from you if…</strong></p> <ul> <li>You’re a strong Product Manager with experience owning complex technical, platform, infrastructure or financial systems.</li> <li>You have enough technical depth to partner credibly with engineers and reason about systems, trade-offs, dependencies and long-term architecture.</li> <li>You’re excited by “boring but critical” infrastructure, things like ledgers, reconciliation, financial data, controls, reporting, internal platforms, abstractions or backend systems.</li> <li>You can work with senior and cross-functional stakeholders, including Finance, Engineering, Product and operational teams.</li> <li>You’re comfortable bringing product thinking into ambiguous or stakeholder-heavy environments, and moving teams from request-led delivery towards long-term strategy.</li> <li>You’re high-agency, ambitious and excited to stretch yourself in a team with a high bar.</li> <li>You care about customers and business outcomes, even when the work is several layers removed from the end customer experience.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! Studies show that women and people of colour might hesitate to apply unless they meet every single requirement. At Monzo, we’re dedicated to creating a diverse and welcoming team. If you’re passionate about this role and keen to learn and grow with us, we encourage you to apply— even if you don’t have everything that's listed just yet. Drop us your application, we’d love to hear from you!<br><br></p> <p><strong>🙌 What’s in it for you</strong></p> <p>💰 £80,000 - £100,000 ➕Incentive Awards tied to your performance.</p> <p>✈️ We’ll help you relocate to the UK.</p> <p>✅ We can sponsor your visa. </p> <p>📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London)</p> <p>⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team. </p> <p>📚 £1,000 learning budget each year to use on books, training courses and conferences.</p> <p>🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide extra support for your work-from-home setup. </p> <p>➕ Plus lots more! <a href="https://monzo.com/careers/">Read our full list of benefits</a>.<br><br><br></p> <p><strong>🌈</strong><strong> The application journey has 3 key steps</strong></p> <p><br><strong>First stage - Meet with our Collective Product Director<br></strong><strong>Second stage - Meet with our Engineering and Finance leadership<br></strong><strong>Third stage - Product full loop</strong></p> <p>This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible! </p> <p>We have some guidelines on using Artificial Intelligence (AI) to ace an application and interview at Monzo. <a href="https://monzo.com/blog/the-ultimate-guide-on-using-ai-to-ace-an-interview-at-monzo">You can read them here.</a></p> <p> </p> <p>We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out. </p> <p> </p> <p>If you’d prefer to work part-time, please let us know and we'll make this happen if we can.</p> <p>Linkedin Tags: #LI-HR1</p><div class="content-conclusion"><hr> <p><strong>Equal opportunities for everyone</strong></p> <p>Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. title: Lead Technical Data Analyst
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>Who We Are</strong></span></p> <p>Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.</p></div><p><span style="text-decoration: underline;"><strong>The Role</strong></span><br>As a <strong>Team Lead, Technical Data Analyst </strong>you will serve as a player-coach - guiding a team of analysts while also executing complex data work yourself. At this level, you are developing your people management skills while leveraging your product, industry, and technical knowledge to advance. You will be the technical anchor for your team, providing the daily guidance needed to navigate complex data challenges and meet project deadlines. You take the vision set by leadership and turn it into reality, ensuring the team stays aligned with our core processes. Your focus is on problem-solving and technical steering, acting as the first line of support to ensure your team's success. This role focused on the functional coaching and project delivery.</p> <p>Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. title: Director, Head of Tax
description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.</p> <p>At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.</p></div><p><strong>Head of Tax – Fanatics International</strong></p> <p>Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.</p> <p>At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day—building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with limitless entrepreneurial spirit, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.</p> <p>As we continue to scale our global platform, the Head of Tax – Fanatics International will play a critical role in owning group-wide tax strategy, compliance, and risk governance across Fanatics International's Commerce, Collectibles (Topps), and Betting and Gaming divisions.</p> <p><strong>ROLE OVERVIEW</strong></p> <p>This is a senior leadership role with group-wide responsibility for tax strategy, compliance, and risk governance across the Fanatics International group — spanning three business verticals (Commerce, Collectibles (Topps), and Betting and Gaming) and multiple legal entities operating across the UK, Europe, and international markets. VAT and indirect tax sit at the heart of this role; Fanatics International operates complex, high-volume supply chains across more than 30 VAT registrations globally, covering marketplace models, dropshipping arrangements, Importer of Record structures, and digital goods supplied to consumers across the UK, EU, and wider international markets. The Head of Tax – Fanatics International delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.</p> <p><strong>HOW WILL YOU DRIVE IMPACT</strong></p> <p>Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.</p> <p><strong>Team & Leadership Impact</strong> (Build Championship Teams)</p> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Partner with the CFO of International Commerce, President of International, Finance leadership, Legal, FP&A, and IT to embed tax considerations into commercial decision-making, ERP configuration, and financial reporting across all three Fanatics International business divisions.</li> <li>Manage and coordinate external adviser relationships — including Big 4 and specialist firms — ensuring timely, accurate, and risk-managed filings across all relevant jurisdictions while maintaining alignment with internal stakeholders.</li> <li>Act as the primary HMRC point of contact for the group, leading the compliance relationship across disputes, product classification claims, Bespoke Retail Scheme management, and audit activity.</li> </ul> <p><strong>People Leadership:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Lead, develop, and grow a high-performing tax team, providing mentorship and clear direction across Commerce, Collectibles (Topps), and Betting and Gaming.</li> <li>Build a scalable tax function with robust governance frameworks, policies, and procedures covering intercompany pricing, VAT compliance, and cross-border structuring.</li> <li>Drive a culture of technical rigour, continuous improvement, and commercially focused advisory across the tax team.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Fan & Customer Impact</strong> (Obsessed with Fans)</p> <ul> <li>Lead the Group's approach to electronically supplied services (ESS) and digital goods VAT/GST across global consumer markets, ensuring accurate and compliant tax treatment that supports seamless fan-facing commerce experiences in every applicable jurisdiction.</li> <li>Provide strategic oversight of VAT compliance across 20+ registrations spanning the UK, EU, and wider international markets, including management of third-party compliance agents, ensuring fans across more than 180 countries are served through compliant and efficient supply chains.</li> <li>Advise on structural and commercial projects including new market launches, M&A, and digital goods tax treatment across UK, EU, and rest of world — enabling Fanatics International to reach fans in new markets with speed and confidence.</li> <li>Maintain strategic oversight of tax engine configuration and ERP-embedded indirect tax logic — including OneSource, Avalara, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 — ensuring accurate VAT determination at the point of transaction so fan purchases are processed correctly at scale.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Innovation & Problem Solving</strong> (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)</p> <ul> <li>Lead ERP and system configuration projects in collaboration with IT and finance operations, translating complex indirect tax requirements into scalable, auditable system logic that keeps pace with Fanatics International's growth trajectory.</li> <li>Drive VAT structuring for complex cross-border arrangements including dropshipping, Importer of Record models, marketplace structures, and intercompany recharges — designing solutions that are both technically robust and commercially enabling.</li> <li>Lead all international tax technical analysis including treaty analysis, withholding tax assessments, and cross-border restructuring advisory, identifying opportunities to improve tax efficiency within a compliant framework.</li> <li>Develop and implement the Group's approach to emerging digital reporting obligations, including e-invoicing compliance across EU jurisdictions, anticipating regulatory change and positioning Fanatics International ahead of compliance deadlines.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ownership & Execution</strong> (Determined & Relentless Mindset)</p> <ul> <li>Own the Group's indirect tax position end-to-end — setting VAT strategy, overseeing compliance execution, and maintaining technical standards across all UK and international registrations with no gaps in accountability.</li> <li>Own and drive the international tax strategy across all three Fanatics International business divisions, maintaining and presenting the Group's international tax risk register to the CFO and President of International on a regular basis.</li> <li>Lead the international tax control framework across all UK entities, including Senior Accounting Officer certification controls, ensuring Board sign-off is fully evidenced and defensible.</li> <li>Own the Group's Criminal Finances Act (Corporate Criminal Offence) compliance programme, including risk assessment, policy ownership, and awareness across the finance population, and lead group relief and loss utilisation planning to maximise tax efficiency across UK entities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY</strong></p> <p>We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:</p> <ul> <li>Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes</li> <li>Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance</li> <li>Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working</li> <li>Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement</li> </ul> <p><strong>CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING</strong></p> <p><strong>Required Qualifications:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep, hands-on expertise in UK and international VAT and indirect tax, with demonstrated technical ownership of a complex, multi-jurisdictional indirect tax position across multiple registrations and jurisdictions — including UK VAT, EU VAT (OSS/IOSS), and wider international indirect taxes such as GST, digital services taxes, and electronically supplied services.</li> <li>Strong understanding of VAT in the context of e-commerce supply chains, including marketplace models, dropshipping, Importer of Record arrangements, and digital goods supplied directly to consumers across global markets.</li> <li>Proven experience of HMRC relationship management in an indirect tax context, including handling audits, disputes, ruling applications, and Bespoke Retail Scheme management.</li> <li>Broader tax expertise across UK corporation tax, transfer pricing, and international tax frameworks — sufficient to lead the Group's wider compliance obligations and provide credible board-level advisory across Fanatics International's three business divisions.</li> <li>Experience building or significantly scaling a tax function, including team development, governance framework design, and implementation of SAO and/or Corporate Criminal Offence compliance programmes.</li> <li>Experience with tax technology and ERP-embedded VAT logic, including OneSource, Avalara, or Microsoft Dynamics 365, with the ability to lead system configuration projects in collaboration with IT and finance operations.</li> <li>Background in e-commerce, retail, digital goods, or sports and entertainment sectors, where indirect tax complexity and cross-border supply chain structure are central to the role.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education:</strong></p> <ul> <li>ACA, CTA, or equivalent professional qualification, with significant post-qualification experience in a senior in-house tax role within a complex, multi-entity international group.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WORK LOCATION</strong></p> <p>Hybrid: The primary place of performance of this role is the Company's office located in <strong>Manchester</strong>, subject to the Company's current hybrid work policy. This role currently requires in-office presence <strong>3 days per week.</strong></p> <p>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset—We Build Championship Teams, we're Obsessed with Fans, we embrace a Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit, and we approach every challenge with a Determined & Relentless Mindset. If you're ready to contribute to a dynamic, fast-paced environment that thrives on collaboration and growth, we want you to be part of our team.</p> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>At Fanatics, we operate with a BOLD mindset - We Build Championship Teams, we’re Obsessed with

Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><h3><span data-contrast="none"><span data-ccp-parastyle="heading 2">About the team</span></span><span data-ccp-props="{"134233117":false,"134233118":false,"335551550":0,"335551620":0,"335559738":320,"335559739":140}"> </span></h3> <p><span data-contrast="auto">The Partner Engineering team’s vision is to establish Roku as the preferred platform of choice for our partners (media companies) to distribute and monetize their content globally. title: Senior / Principal Materials Scientist, AI Safety
description: <p><strong>Your Impact at LILA</strong></p> <p>We're building a talent-dense, high-agency AI safety team at Lila that will engage all core teams within the organization (science, model training, lab integration, etc.), to identify and mitigate risks from scientific superintelligence while retaining the core scientific discovery capabilities of the stack. The initial focus of this team will be to build and implement a bespoke safety strategy for Lila, tailored to its specific goals and deployment strategies. This will involve technical safety strategy development, broader ecosystem engagement, safety-focused evaluations, safety systems to mitigate risks, and a research agenda that explores longer-term needs such as oversight of superintelligent scientific systems.</p> <p>We are seeking a materials scientist to map risk across the material sciences domain: you will connect deep materials expertise with dual-use risk assessment to help safeguard increasingly capable scientific AI. You will investigate how advances in materials research could change harmful capabilities, including established and emerging threats.</p> <p><strong>What You'll Be Building</strong></p> <ul> <li>Map misuse risks by connecting material properties, processing and functional performance (across a range of materials domains) to harmful applications, including emerging or overlooked uses of scientific advances.</li> <li>Assess how physical feasibility, processing complexity, manufacturing requirements and actors' resources affect the plausibility and likelihood of misuse, including which constraints AI could change.</li> <li>Distinguish established capabilities, plausible future developments and weakly supported hypotheses, revising assessments as evidence changes across models, tools and automated laboratories.</li> <li>Identify gaps in expertise, commission targeted scientific input with the expert-program team, and integrate specialist findings into a coherent assessment of the risk landscape.</li> <li>Translate dual-use judgments into policy boundaries, evaluation priorities and mitigation requirements that support beneficial materials research.</li> <li>Work with threat modelers, evaluation researchers and engineering and experimental colleagues to assess capabilities, interpret red-team findings and evaluate safeguards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You'll Need to Succeed</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deep expertise (a PhD, or comparable experience) in materials science or a closely related discipline, with a strong grasp of the relationships between structure, properties, processing and applications. Relevant backgrounds include particulate, porous and formulated systems; and structural and functional materials, including thin films, electrochemical materials and metals and alloys.</li> <li>Substantive experience assessing dual-use risks in a relevant area, with a strong understanding of harmful applications such as nuclear proliferation, radiological misuse, weapons-related capabilities (e.g. energetics) or other consequential materials risks.</li> <li>Sound judgment about physical possibility, practical feasibility and uncertainty, together with the ability to investigate risks beyond your immediate specialism.</li> <li>The ability to identify appropriate specialists, evaluate technical evidence and synthesize contributions across scientific and security disciplines.</li> <li>Clear scientific communication, independent research judgment and an ability to collaborate across science, engineering and policy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points For</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience applying materials or related physical-science expertise to AI safety through one or more of: threat analysis, evaluations or red teaming, or mitigation design.</li> <li>Experience commissioning specialist research or assessing emerging technologies across disciplinary boundaries.</li> <li>Experience with computational materials science, advanced manufacturing or automated synthesis and characterization.</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.</p> <p><strong>U.S. Benefits.</strong> Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.</p> <p><strong>International Benefits.</strong> Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.</p></div><div class="title">Expected Base Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$268,000</span><span class="divider">—</span><span>$384,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About LILA</strong></p> <p>Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.</p> <p>LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.</p> <p>Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.</p> <p><strong>We’re All In</strong></p> <p>Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.</p> <p>Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our <a href="https://www.lila.ai/candidate-privacy-policy-notice">Candidate Privacy Policy</a>.</p> <p><strong>A Note to Agencies</strong></p> <p><em>Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.</em></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Enterprise Sales Leader (UK-based)
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. 🎯 Your main goal will be to build one of n8n’s most predictable Enterprise sales teams. You’ll develop high-performing Enterprise AEs, instill forecast and pipeline discipline, and create a repeatable operating model that wins complex, multi-stakeholder deals. To make that happen, you’ll be hands-on in coaching, deal inspection, and team development day-to-day, while staying close enough to strategic deals and customer executives to raise the bar on how we qualify, forecast, and win: DEVELOPING A HIGH-PERFORMING, PREDICTABLE TEAM Coach and develop a team of Enterprise AEs through structured 1:1s, field coaching, and deal reviews, raising both the floor and the ceiling on individual performance. Build a rigorous forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes your numbers predictable quarter over quarter, not dependent on late-quarter heroics. Create a repeatable operating model with clear playbooks, MEDDIC/MEDDPICC-based deal inspection, and coaching rhythms, so execution doesn’t rely on you personally driving every strategic deal. Hire, onboard, and scale the team quickly, establishing career paths and succession plans as we grow. SETTING THE STRATEGY FOR YOUR TERRITORY Prioritize and run your Enterprise territory with focus, balancing new logo pursuits with expansion plays where community signals are strong. Set the strategy for the team’s most complex enterprise cycles, from discovery to close, staying close enough to coach without taking the pen. Elevate sales methodology adoption (MEDDIC/MEDDPICC), ensuring meticulous qualification, mutual action plans, and disciplined inspection of technical and business wins. BUILDING A STRATEGIC, MULTI-THREADED SELLING MOTION Build a strategic selling culture that shifts the team from “running opportunities” to multi-threaded, value-led enterprise execution. Orchestrate executive engagement across your accounts, aligning economic buyers, champions, and technical evaluators to keep momentum and unblock deals. Run high-quality deal reviews and QBRs that sharpen strategy, elevate coaching moments, and improve win rates, cycle time, and forecast accuracy. PARTNERING ACROSS THE BUSINESS Collaborate cross-functionally with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product to refine messaging for technical buyers, strengthen the enterprise playbook, and remove friction in the sales process. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves 🏆 Enterprise sales leadership: You have 5+ years in frontline sales management, leading ICs through complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals. 🔎 MEDDIC/MEDDPICC mastery: You have deep, practical command of MEDDIC/MEDDPICC and a track record of coaching teams to adopt it with real inspection. 📈 Forecast & pipeline rigor: You’ve run a disciplined forecasting and pipeline management cadence that makes revenue predictable, not reactive. 🧠 Strategic deal management: You’re fluent in qualification, mutual action plans, champion building, and executive alignment in longer-cycle deals. 🎙️ Executive presence: You confidently engage senior stakeholders, run tight meetings, and set a high bar for clarity, urgency, and outcomes. 🧑‍🏫 Coaching & talent development: You level up AEs through structured coaching, field observation, and actionable feedback. 🧩 Multi-stakeholder navigation: You’re skilled at aligning technical and economic buyers, de-escalating conflict, and maintaining deal momentum. 🇬🇧 UK location: You’re based in the UK and happy being on-site with customers once per week on average 🇬🇧 English: You’re a native or bilingual speaker of English. 🔧 Technical-buyer credibility: You have experience selling into technical stakeholders and navigating evaluation-heavy sales motions. 🖥️ Open-source / PLG experience: You understand how community and bottoms-up adoption influence enterprise outcomes and how to partner with that motion. Nice-to-haves Additional languages: You're fluent in French or Spanish. 🌉 Developer / infra SaaS background: You’ve worked in DevOps, SecOps, IT Ops, data, infrastructure, or adjacent categories. 💡 Scrappy startup mindset: You’ve scaled in environments where playbooks are evolving, and you enjoy building structure without slowing teams down. 📊 Operational excellence: You have strong instincts for clean forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and turning data into coaching and better execution. Why join us? You’ll take a team of Enterprise AEs and turn it into a repeatable engine, in one of the fastest-growing open-source companies in Europe. The playbooks you build and the people you hire will shape how n8n sells to the world’s biggest technical organizations. You’ll work directly with Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, RevOps, and Product, so your voice carries well beyond your own team. n8n is a remote-first company with a passionate community of builders, a culture of autonomy and experimentation, and a very high bar for talent. If you want to build something that lasts while the company scales, apply now and help us make n8n the default way enterprises automate. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement. title: Senior Finance Business Partner
description: Senior Finance Business Partner, UK Finance About us: We built ClearBank on the belief that banking infrastructure would no longer slow down progress. Instead, it would be a catalyst that unlocks the potential to innovate. It would adapt to different needs so a new era in financial services could begin. We’re here to challenge the status quo in banking, are you? We all know that transforming banking forever is not an easy mission, but we’re more than ready to rise to that challenge. We all do it every day; navigating new, unexpected and sometimes even daunting challenges. But we believe in ourselves and trust we can do it. Want to innovate? Go for it. Push for a better way? You Can. If you think you have it in you, this is Where You Can. Role Purpose As Senior Finance Business Partner, you’ll play a key strategic and operational leadership role within our UK Finance team, reporting to the UK CFO. You’ll provide independent financial oversight and insight across the UK Bank, deputise for the UK CFO when required and connect UK Finance with Group Finance teams. The role combines financial control, regulatory oversight, planning and commercial finance to support effective decision-making and sustainable performance. This is a visible senior role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial judgement and the confidence to influence and constructively challenge senior stakeholders. Key Responsibilities Deputise for the UK CFO, including supporting interactions with the Board and Executive Committee. Lead the relationship between UK Finance and Group Finance, ensuring services meet UK regulatory and operational requirements. Maintain independent oversight of the UK Bank’s financial position, constructively challenging and validating Group Finance outputs. Lead UK financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting and performance reporting. Partner with the UK leadership team on business cases, profitability and strategic decision-making. Support the review of regulatory submissions and the preparation of Board and Executive Committee papers. Monitor compliance with UK regulatory and prudential requirements, escalating risks and control weaknesses appropriately. Improve financial processes and reporting to strengthen clarity, accuracy and timeliness. Act as a trusted adviser to the UK CFO and senior stakeholders, providing clear financial insight and challenge. Contribute financial leadership to strategic initiatives, including growth planning and operational resilience. Skills & Experience A recognised accountancy qualification, such as ACA, ACCA, CIMA or an equivalent, with significant post-qualification experience in financial services. Broad finance experience covering financial control, reporting, planning and commercial finance. Strong knowledge of UK GAAP and IFRS. Experience of regulatory and prudential requirements, including PRA and FCA frameworks, ICAAP, ILAAP, and recovery and resolution planning. Experience working within a regulated UK banking environment. Strong budgeting, forecasting, performance analysis and business-case development skills. Experience working effectively across a matrix organisation. Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the confidence to engage and constructively challenge at Board and Executive level. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to simplify complexity and focus on material issues. Sound professional judgement, independence and professional scepticism. A collaborative, outcome-focused approach, with the ability to take ownership, identify risks early and support shared goals. Ways of Working & Culture Build Trust Together : Take ownership of outcomes, maintain high standards of integrity and create confidence through reliable delivery and strong controls. Work effectively as part of a small, hands-on team, taking accountability for delivery while helping to improve and scale processes as the Finance function grows. Care Like We Mean It : Support colleagues, provide constructive challenge and create an environment where people can perform at their best. Grow With The Challenge : Embrace change, continuously develop expertise and proactively seek opportunities to improve ways of working. Succeed As One : Work collaboratively across teams and functions, recognising that the best outcomes are achieved together. Clear A Bold New Path : Challenge existing processes, champion innovation and help build scalable finance capabilities for the future. If this sounds like you, then we encourage you to dust off that CV and apply! *Please note that we are not currently able to sponsor applicants for immigration purposes. A little bit more about us! ClearBank is Where You Can belong: At ClearBank we think about Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DE&I) a lot. Not because we think we should. But because we know we should – how else can we build a happy workforce and be successful as a business. We’re committed to making sure our teams reflect society. And we put energy and effort into making this a place where everyone feels at home, where they’re given the trust and encouragement to do their very best work. Here are some of the things we’re most proud of: 42% of our senior management roles are held by women Our enhanced family leave policies Launching our partnership with Code First Girls Increasing awareness of neurodiversity in the workplace through our partnership with the Inclusive Group Our hiring process and what you can expect: Application: a member of our talent acquisition team will review your application against the key requirements for the role and let you know within two weeks whether you’re moving forward to the next stage; Screening: You’ll spend 30-45 minutes speaking to one of our recruiters learning more about the role and ClearBank, and we’ll get it know more about you, your experience and how your skills align with the role (this will be via phone or Teams video call). title: Customer Success Manager - Enterprise
description: About Hiya At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective. Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve. Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes. This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed. About the Role You’ll own a portfolio of Hiya’s largest enterprise customers across the UK and Europe, with full accountability for retention, renewals and expansion. As a trusted adviser to their senior leaders, you’ll prove the measurable value of Hiya Connect and grow each account over time. You’ll work closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product and Hiya’s leadership team. You’ll need fluent English and business-level proficiency in at least one of French, Spanish or German, as you’ll manage many of your European accounts in those languages. What You'll Do Own 20–25 strategic enterprise accounts across the UK and Europe. You’ll be accountable for gross and net revenue retention, renewals and expansion. Build executive relationships from Director to C-level, working across customer experience, contact centre, marketing, fraud, security and procurement. Develop strategic account plans that map each customer’s objectives, success metrics, buying centres and whitespace into a clear growth roadmap. Lead executive and quarterly business reviews that quantify return on investment (ROI), such as answer-rate uplift, contact-centre efficiency and fraud reduction, and agree next priorities. Run complex renewals and multi-year negotiations covering pricing, contract structure, procurement, legal and security, and forecast them accurately in the CRM. Partner with Sales and Solutions Engineering to find and close expansion across new business units, geographies, use cases and Hiya products. Spot risk early through usage, health and relationship signals. Turn customer insight into clear input for Product, Engineering and Marketing. What We Are Looking For Typically 5+ years in customer success, strategic account management or enterprise account management at a B2B SaaS or technology company Fluent English plus business-level proficiency in at least one of French, Spanish or German, with the confidence to lead executive conversations, renewals and commercial negotiations in that language A track record of owning and growing large, complex enterprise accounts, including six- or seven-figure renewals and expansions against a net revenue retention (NRR) or quota target Experience influencing senior executives and working through large organisations with many stakeholders Strong commercial sense: you can build a value case, lead a negotiation and link product capabilities to a customer’s financial and operational outcomes Experience creating and running strategic account plans and executive business reviews You’ll Likely Stand Out If You Have Experience managing enterprise customers in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, telecoms, utilities or healthcare, ideally across several European countries A background in communications technology, CPaaS, contact-centre solutions, caller ID, fraud prevention or conversation intelligence Working knowledge of UK and EU regulation on caller ID, spam and fraud A record of turning customer feedback into product or go-to-market improvements How We Work Hiya is not a passive environment. We expect people to take ownership, form opinions, and engage directly with hard problems. We work with a high degree of transparency and autonomy . description: About CuspAI CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. Electronics : Semiconductor processing, device-level modelling and electronics, photonic and thermal materials Energy : Catalysis, batteries, photovoltaics and multiscale kinetics. Science and campaigns Apply and extend our platform to partner problems, using simulation, machine learning, data-driven optimisation, or experiments as the project requires. Capability and product development Build and automate workflows that run reliably at scale within our platform. Stay informed about advances in your field and contribute to the scientific direction of your team. At the same time, you solve problems analytically and pragmatically, both independently and as part of the team.</p> <ul> <li>5 - 8 years of relevant experience in application consulting, marketing builds, and marketing automation workflows.</li> <li>Subject matter expertise in at least one major marketing technology platform, such as Adobe Campaign, Adobe Journey Optimizer, Marketo Engage, Braze or a comparable CRM or marketing automation tool.</li> <li>Advanced understanding of campaign execution processes, including requirements assessment, technical debriefing, build, QA, testing, deployment, monitoring, and optimisation.</li> <li>Ability to independently assess, develop, and maintain scalable, future-proof campaign solutions.</li> <li>Experience contributing to or consulting on campaign solution design from scratch.</li> <li>Ability to develop and execute UAT tests at campaign or programme level.</li> <li>Experience supporting technical documentation, including solution requirements, specifications, campaign documentation, and process documentation.</li> <li>Strong understanding of marketing operations, customer journeys, lifecycle communications, triggered campaigns, segmentation, and campaign performance objectives.</li> <li>Good understanding of business acumen and client strategy, with the ability to apply this knowledge in day-to-day delivery and consulting.</li> <li>Experience working with cross-functional teams, including developers, architects, data teams, project managers, technical project managers, marketing operations, and account teams.</li> <li>Knowledge of data usage within campaign execution, including audience selection, validation, segmentation, QA, and data-driven campaign logic.</li> <li>Relevant platform certifications or accreditations are an advantage, depending on the technology stack, such as AJO certification, Adobe Campaign certification, Braze, or similar.</li> <li>Strong passion for Marketing Technology and staying abreast of the latest AI developments.</li> <li>Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.</li> </ul> <h2>A leader in personalized customer experiences</h2> <p>MAP is a title: Senior Manager, HR Process Excellence
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Who We Are </strong></p> <p>Verve has created a more efficient and privacy-focused way to buy and monetize advertising. Verve is an ecosystem of demand and supply technologies fusing data, media, and technology together to deliver results and growth to both advertisers and publishers–no matter the screen or location, no matter who, what, or where a customer is. With offices across the globe and with an eye on servicing forward-thinking advertising customers, Verve’s solutions are trusted by more than 90 of the United States’ top 100 advertisers, 4,000 publishers globally, and the world’s top demand-side platforms. Learn more at <a href="https://verve.com/">verve.com</a>.<strong><br></strong></p></div><p><strong>What we're looking for:</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a commercially minded <strong>Senior Manager, HR Process Excellence</strong> to drive the design, optimisation and continuous improvement of HR processes across Verve Group. </p> <p>As the subject matter expert (SME) for HR process excellence, you will partner with HR leadership and leaders across the organisation. title: Agentic AI Principal
description: <div class="description content"> <p>We are looking for an <strong>Agentic AI Principal</strong> to act as a senior technical authority and trusted client advisor for complex agentic AI transformation in the UK and Ireland.</p> <p>Operating at Principal level, you will shape enterprise AI strategy, define agentic architecture blueprints, lead high-value C-suite engagements and guide complex programmes from opportunity through delivery. You will bring deep hands-on credibility in multi-agent systems, governance and safeguards, while setting reusable patterns and raising capability across teams.</p> <p>The role has particular focus on sovereign, compliant and production-grade agentic AI for regulated UK enterprise environments, including financial services and telecommunications.</p> </div> <h2 id="job-responsibilities">Job responsibilities</h2> <div class="job-responsibilities content"> <ul> <li><strong>Agentic AI Advisory & Strategy: </strong>Shape and solution complex UKI pursuits, working with account, commercial and delivery leaders to translate client needs into differentiated propositions, credible architectures and executable delivery approaches that support regional pipeline conversion.</li> <li><strong>Design & Build Engineering:</strong> Set the architecture direction for complex, production-grade agentic AI systems, including multi-agent workflows, orchestration, tool use, memory, context strategy, retrieval, evaluation, observability and enterprise integration.</li> <li><strong>Governance & Safeguards: </strong>Establish reusable patterns for observability, auditability, traceability and control of agentic systems, enabling teams to demonstrate safe and reliable behaviour in production.</li> <li><strong>Principal-level leadership: </strong>Set reusable architecture patterns, engineering standards and governance practices across multiple teams and engagements, influencing the evolution of Thoughtworks’ agentic AI capability beyond an individual programme.</li> <li>Design solutions appropriate for regulated UK environments, including financial services and telecommunications, with strong consideration of data sovereignty, privacy, security, responsible AI and applicable regulatory requirements.</li> <li>Provide technical and delivery leadership for complex programmes, maintaining sufficient hands-on involvement to validate architecture, unblock teams, manage technical risk and ensure successful execution.</li> <li>Set technical direction across multiple teams and initiatives, defining reusable patterns, frameworks and engineering standards for agentic AI delivery.</li> <li>Guide teams in balancing rapid experimentation with robust production engineering, including evaluation-driven development, testing, CI/CD, reliability, cost and performance optimisation.</li> <li>Partner with product, data, software engineering, enterprise architecture, governance and change specialists to design end-to-end solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.</li> <li>Anticipate technical, organisational and governance challenges in enterprise AI adoption and define practical approaches to address them.</li> <li>Mentor senior engineers and technical leads, uplift broader engineering capability, and build confidence in agentic AI practices across specialists and generalists.</li> <li>Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies and frameworks and guide their responsible adoption based on client context, engineering quality and business value.</li> <li>Represent Thoughtworks' agentic AI expertise in strategic client conversations, industry forums, partnerships and thought leadership where appropriate.</li> </ul> </div> <h2 id="job-qualifications">Job qualifications</h2> <div class="job-qualifications content"> <h3 id="technical-skills">Technical Skills</h3> <div class="qualifications inner-content"> <ul> <li>Deep expertise in modern software engineering and Python, with a strong track record of setting standards for testing, CI/CD, observability, maintainability and production reliability.</li> <li>Recognised experience architecting and delivering complex GenAI and agentic AI systems at enterprise scale, from early discovery through production deployment.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of agentic architectures and frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex or equivalent, including tool use, orchestration, memory and multi-t coordination patterns.</li> <li>Strong expertise in Retrieval-Augmented Generation, advanced information retrieval, vector databases and enterprise knowledge integration.</li> <li>Experience designing evaluation strategies for GenAI and agentic systems, including quality, safety, reliability, latency and cost measures.</li> <li>Strong understanding of AI governance and safeguards, including guardrails, red-teaming, observability, responsible AI and secure deployment practices.</li> <li>Significant experience deploying AI systems on major cloud platforms using containers, orchestration and production-grade infrastructure patterns.</li> <li>Experience with model adaptation and optimisation techniques, including prompt/context engineering, fine-tuning where appropriate, and application-level performance optimisation.</li> <li>Ability to make sound architecture trade-offs across model capability, reliability, security, compliance, performance and cost.</li> </ul> </div> <h3 id="professional-skills">Professional Skills</h3> <div class="skills inner-content"> <ul> <li>Proven ability to lead C-suite and senior client engagements, rapidly establish credibility and advise on both business and technical choices.</li> <li>Strong consulting and commercial judgement, including experience shaping high-value opportunities, building investment cases and contributing directly to complex pipeline conversion.</li> <li>Ability to lead AI maturity assessments, identify and prioritise processes for agentization, and connect architecture choices to measurable business value and ROI.</li> <li>Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to make complex agentic AI concepts, risks and trade-offs clear to technical and non-technical audiences.</li> <li>Proven leadership of complex delivery across multidisciplinary teams, with the ability to move fluidly between strategy, architecture, governance and hands-on technical leadership.</li> <li>Ability to influence across organisations without relying on formal authority, align diverse stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in high-value or high-risk programmes.</li> <li>Proven ability to mentor senior engineers and technical leaders and to raise standards and capability across a wider engineering community.</li> </ul> </div> </div> <h2 id="important-things">Other things to know</h2> <div class="important-things content"> <h3>Learning & Development</h3> <div class="inner-content"> <p>There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. This means your career is supported by interactive tools, numerous development programs and teammates who want to help you grow. We see value in helping each other be our best and that extends to empowering our employees in their career journeys.</p> </div> </div> <h2 id="responsible-ai-use">Responsible Use of AI in Recruitment</h2> <div class="responsible-ai-use content"> <p>At Thoughtworks, we use AI tools to support our recruitment team with administrative tasks such as drafting communications, scheduling interviews and writing job descriptions.<br><br>Crucially, our AI tools do not screen, assess, rank or make hiring decisions. Every application is reviewed by our team and all selection decisions are made exclusively by our interviewers and hiring managers.<br><br>We are committed to fairness and responsible AI. We actively manage our AI systems by testing, monitoring for biased outcomes and implementing mitigation measures. We hold our third-party vendors to these same high standards through a rigorous governance process. For additional information, please see our full <a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment" target="_blank">Thoughtworks AI Policy for Recruitment</a>.</p> </div> <h2 id="about">About Thoughtworks</h2> <div class="about content"> <p>Thoughtworks is a dynamic and inclusive community of bright and supportive colleagues who are revolutionizing tech. As a leading technology consultancy, we’re pushing boundaries through our purposeful and impactful work. For 30+ years, we’ve delivered extraordinary impact together with our clients by helping them solve complex business problems with technology as the differentiator. Bring your brilliant expertise and commitment for continuous learning to Thoughtworks. Together, let’s be extraordinary.</p> </div> <p style="display: none;">#LI-Hybrid</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p style="text-align: center;"><a href="https://www.thoughtworks.com/careers/ai-policy-for-recruitment">See here our AI policy.</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, International Security & Privacy Compliance
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p>CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="http://www.coreweave.com/">www.coreweave.com</a>.</p> <h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>CoreWeave is taking its AI cloud and data center services to new countries. Each new market brings its own data protection, cybersecurity, and data residency requirements, and we have to meet them before we launch.</p> <p>As the Technical Program Manager for International Security & Privacy Compliance, you will own the program that gets CoreWeave compliant in each new market. You will turn local legal and regulatory requirements into controls, timelines, and owners. Then you will lead Legal, Privacy, Security, Data Center Operations, Product, and Go-to-Market through to a compliant launch. The problem is defined; the solution is not. You will build the playbook as you go and make it repeatable for each market that follows.</p> <p>The role is based in London so you can work during business hours with US teams and with teams in the Middle East and Asia-Pacific.</p> <h2><strong>What You'll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end compliance program for new-country launches, from early regulatory assessment through go-live and ongoing upkeep.</li> <li>Work with Legal and Privacy counsel to turn local laws into concrete technical and operational requirements. These cover data protection and privacy, cybersecurity, data localization and residency, cross-border data transfer, incident reporting, and registration or licensing. Legal owns the interpretation; you own turning it into delivery.</li> <li>Map country requirements to CoreWeave's existing control framework (SOC 2, ISO/IEC 27001, and related certifications). Find gaps and drive the work to close them with control owners in Security, Engineering, and Data Center Operations.</li> <li>Build and maintain source-of-truth program plans, a requirements register, and a dependency map for each market. Use them to drive high-quality execution against timelines leadership can rely on.</li> <li>Build country-specific incident and breach notification obligations into CoreWeave's incident response process before go-live.</li> <li>Find risks and blockers early, such as data residency limits on architecture, local vendor or partner obligations, and regulator timelines. Drive them to resolution across teams, or escalate them with clear options and tradeoffs.</li> <li>Coordinate privacy reviews and data protection impact assessments for in-country services, working with Privacy and Product.</li> <li>Bring compliance requirements into product and data center launch plans early, so customer-facing commitments, contracts, and Trust Center content reflect what we can actually deliver.</li> <li>Report program status, risk, and decisions needed to Security, Legal, and business leadership.</li> <li>Make the work repeatable. Turn each market's lessons into a scalable country-entry playbook, templates, and workflows in Jira and our GRC tooling.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who You Are</strong></h2> <ul> <li>[5+] years of relevant experience in international security and privacy compliance program management, GRC, or related technical program management, preferably at a cloud, data center, or infrastructure provider.</li> <li>A track record of managing end-to-end, large-scale, cross-functional programs with significant organizational impact under little or no supervision. You are comfortable with work that has a defined problem but no defined solution.</li> <li>Strong execution skills. You get things done to high quality on timelines people can trust.</li> <li>You identify risks and blockers early and drive them to resolution.</li> <li>A solid grounding in industry best practices and frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, ISO/IEC 27701, SOC 2, NIST CSF, and GDPR-style data protection regimes. You can make well-reasoned decisions and tradeoffs that fit CoreWeave's context.</li> <li>You quickly learn and keep up with the requirements of unfamiliar jurisdictions, well enough to take an active part in decisions with Legal, Security, and Engineering.</li> <li>You use feedback to shape priorities, and you make sure compliance solutions don't degrade the customer experience.</li> <li>You influence cross-functional decisions with a structured approach, data, and technical insight, to achieve the intended outcome. You also contribute to the wider CoreWeave community, for example by mentoring others.</li> <li>You win buy-in from critical stakeholders on your recommendations, define clear communication strategies tailored to the audience, from engineers to executives, and seek out feedback to improve how you work.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Preferred</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience running compliance programs across several countries, especially in Asia-Pacific or the Middle East.</li> <li>Experience with data residency, sovereign cloud, or in-country hosting requirements for cloud or data center services.</li> <li>Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, CISSP, CISM, CISA, or PMP.</li> <li>Experience with GRC platforms and with Jira-based program tracking.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Wondering if you're a good fit? We believe in investing in our people and value candidates who bring unique backgrounds, even if you don't check every box. Here are a few qualities we've found make someone successful on our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</strong></p> <ul> <li>You're comfortable balancing compliance rigor with practical, scalable solutions.</li> <li>You take ownership, bring structure to ambiguity, and follow issues through to resolution.</li> <li>You communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders and build strong cross-functional partnerships.</li> <li>You're energized by building processes and systems that improve how teams work.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. Any unsolicited CVs received will be treated as the property of CoreWeave and your Terms & Conditions associated with the use of CVs will be considered null and void.</em></em></span></p> <p><em><span style="font-weight: 400;"><em data-stringify-type="italic">Any unsolicited CVs sent by your company to us – that is to say, in any situation where we have not directly engaged your company in writing to supply candidates for a specific vacancy – will be considered by us to be a “free gift”, leaving us liable for no fees whatsoever should we choose to contact the candidate directly and engage the candidate’s services, and will in no way establish any prior claim by your company to representation of that candidate should the candidate’s details also be submitted by any other party.</em></span></em></p> <p><strong>Export Control Compliance</strong></p> <p>This position requires access to export controlled information.  To conform to U.S. Government export regulations applicable to that information, applicant must either be (A) a U.S. person, defined as a (i) U.S. citizen or national, (ii) U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), (iii) refugee under 8 U.S.C. § 1157, or (iv) asylee under 8 U.S.C. § 1158, (B) eligible to access the export controlled information without a required export authorization, or (C) eligible and reasonably likely to obtain the required export authorization from the applicable U.S. government agency.  CoreWeave may, for legitimate business reasons, decline to pursue any export licensing process.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong><em>Updated privacy notice - UK and EU Job Applications </em></strong></p> <p><em>When you apply to a job on this site, the personal data contained in your application will be collected by CoreWeave UK Ltd.
